blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five V194 views and six pose renders: the neutral skirt still has dense, irregular vertical folds and a puckered waist junction. The crouch shows skirt panels flaring into sharp folded tails with exposed anterior thighs; sit leaves most of the lap area uncovered. Pose-matched ray coverage is only 52/532 triangles (9.8%) in crouch and 22/532 (4.1%) in sit; visual fit remains unacceptable.

V194 front, side, three-quarter, back and prone views still show angular planar folds across the bodice, a gray waist-side patch with unverified garment-surface ownership, and an uneven waist/back transition. The jacket surface remains visibly unfinished.

The V194 per-authored-row line search preserves 108 lap-hem vertices and 262 shared panel-boundary vertices, but minimum orientation-safe row scales remain 0.0141/0.0171 on the two lap panels. Mean applied displacement blend is 0.158; maximum rest displacement is 0.0101 m and maximum nearest-surface distance remains 0.1447 m. Crouch coverage only changes from 48/532 in V193 to 52/532; sit remains 22/532. This is diagnostic prototype geometry, not fit acceptance.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
